openalex.key_notice.en: [CONFIG] OpenAlex API key NOT configured — running in keyless mode (100 credits/day, easily rate-limited / HTTP 429). Configure the FREE key from {url} and retrieval gets FASTER: with a key, OpenAlex queries run directly on this machine in the keyed pool (~100k credits/day, no 429) instead of the remote pool. Your key NEVER leaves this computer (local direct-connect only). Tell the assistant in chat to set it up (writes `OPENALEX_API_KEY=<key>` to the skill `.env`; never echoed back or logged), or add it yourself to `.env` / an env var / `--openalex-key`, then re-run.
openalex.key_notice.zh: [配置] 未配置 OpenAlex API key —— 当前以 keyless 模式运行（限 100 次/天，易触发 HTTP 429 限流）。到 {url} 免费申请并配置后，检索会快很多：有 key 时 OpenAlex 在本机 keyed pool（约 10 万次/天、不 429）本地直连检索，且 key 绝不会外发（仅本机使用，不经过云端）。在对话里告诉助手帮你配置（写入技能目录 `.env` 的 `OPENALEX_API_KEY=<key>`，绝不回显、不写日志），或自行写入 `.env` / 环境变量 / `--openalex-key` 后重新运行即可。

semantic_scholar.key_notice.en: [CONFIG] Semantic Scholar API key NOT configured — keyless pool is strict (~1 req/s) and may block; without a key this source is skipped. Configure the FREE key from https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api and retrieval gets FASTER: with a key, Semantic Scholar queries run directly on this machine (1 RPS dedicated pool) instead of being skipped. Your key NEVER leaves this computer (local direct-connect only). Tell the assistant in chat to set it up (writes `SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY=<key>` to the skill `.env`; never echoed back or logged) or add it yourself.
semantic_scholar.key_notice.zh: [配置] 未配置 Semantic Scholar API key —— keyless 池极严格（约 1 次/秒）并可能封禁，无 key 时该源直接跳过。到 https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api 免费申请并配置后，检索会快很多：有 key 时 Semantic Scholar 在本机专属配额（1 次/秒稳定）本地直连检索，且 key 绝不会外发（仅本机使用，不经过云端）。在对话里告诉助手帮你配置（写入技能目录 `.env` 的 `SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY=<key>`，绝不回显、不写日志），或自行写入。

http.429.keyless_notice.en: ⚠️ Rate limit hit (HTTP 429): no API key -> keyless pool (100 credits/day). Briefly retrying; if it still fails the run will auto-degrade to other sources.
http.429.keyless_notice.zh: ⚠️ 命中限流（HTTP 429）：未带 API key，落在无 key 池（每日 100 次配额）。正在快速重试；若仍失败将自动降级到其他数据源。

http.429.notice.en: ⚠️ Rate limit hit (HTTP 429); server suggests retry after {secs} s. Backing off as instructed...
http.429.notice.zh: ⚠️ 命中限流（HTTP 429），服务端建议 {secs} 秒后重试。正在按建议退避……

openalex.rate_limited.en: ⚠️ OpenAlex was rate-limited (HTTP 429, keyless mode). This run used only other sources (e.g. Europe PMC). Apply for a FREE API key, write it to the skill `.env` (`OPENALEX_API_KEY=<key>`), then re-run for full coverage: {url}
openalex.rate_limited.zh: ⚠️ OpenAlex 触发限流（HTTP 429，keyless 模式）。本次结果仅来自其他数据源（如 Europe PMC）。建议免费申请 API key 并写入技能目录 `.env`（`OPENALEX_API_KEY=<key>`）后重跑以获得完整覆盖：{url}

source.rate_limited.en: ⚠️ {source} was rate-limited (HTTP 429). This run used only other available sources.
source.rate_limited.zh: ⚠️ {source} 触发限流（HTTP 429）。本次结果仅来自其他可用数据源。

source.error.en: ❌ {source} fetch failed: {err}. This run used only other available sources.
source.error.zh: ❌ {source} 检索失败：{err}。本次结果仅来自其他可用数据源。

dry_run.not_executed.en: [DRY RUN — code not executed. Remove --dry-run to execute.]
dry_run.not_executed.zh: [DRY RUN — 代码未执行。去掉 --dry-run 以执行。]

safe_preview.not_executed.en: [SAFE PREVIEW] R code was NOT executed. Re-run with --yes to compute the result.
safe_preview.not_executed.zh: [安全预览] R 代码未执行。追加 --yes 重新运行以计算结果。]

run.starting.en: 🔎 Literature search started. Results may take a few minutes to return — typically {est}. ({vmode}; larger result sets or rate-limit backoff take longer.) Output → {out}
run.starting.zh: 🔎 文献检索已开始。返回结果可能需等待数分钟——通常 {est}。（{vmode}；结果集越大或遇限流退避时更久。）输出 → {out}

run.busy_hint.en: 📚 Searching configured academic databases via Coze — retrieval may take a while. Do not resubmit the same query; results will appear here when ready.
run.busy_hint.zh: 📚 正在通过 Coze 检索已配置的多个学术数据库——检索可能耗时较长。请勿重复提交相同 query，结果就绪后此处会更新。

snowball.starting.en: 🔗 Expanding citation network (snowballing) from top-{seeds} seed works via OpenAlex references + cited_by (max {max_per_seed} per seed)...
snowball.starting.zh: 🔗 正在通过 OpenAlex 引用网络扩展（滚雪球）——从 top-{seeds} 种子文献的 references + cited_by 扩展（每种子最多 {max_per_seed} 篇）...

snowball.done.en: ✅ Snowball added {added} works from citation network (seeds: {seeds}, deduped against existing corpus).
snowball.done.zh: ✅ 滚雪球从引用网络新增 {added} 篇（种子数：{seeds}，已对现有语料去重）。

snowball.empty.en: ⚠️ Snowball returned no additional works (seeds may have few references / cited_by in OpenAlex).
snowball.empty.zh: ⚠️ 滚雪球未返回新增文献（种子文献在 OpenAlex 的 references / cited_by 可能较少）。

snowball.skipped.en: Snowball skipped (use --snowball to enable citation-network expansion).
snowball.skipped.zh: 滚雪球已跳过（使用 --snowball 启用引用网络扩展）。

snowball_from.not_found.en: ⚠️ Could not resolve seed '{seed}' to an OpenAlex work (DOI / PMID / title not found). Check the identifier or try a different form.
snowball_from.not_found.zh: ⚠️ 无法将种子 '{seed}' 解析为 OpenAlex 文献（DOI / PMID / 题名未命中）。请检查标识符或换一种形式。

snowball_from.done.en: 🔗 Citation network expanded: {total} works (seed + {fwd} forward-cited + {bwd} backward-referenced).
snowball_from.done.zh: 🔗 引文网络已扩展：共 {total} 篇（种子 + 前向施引 {fwd} + 后向参考文献 {bwd}）。

interactive.confirm_search.en: 🔎 Search strategy confirmed. Proceeding with literature retrieval...
interactive.confirm_search.zh: 🔎 搜索策略已确认，开始文献检索...

interactive.confirm_screening.en: ✅ Screening confirmed. Borderline cases logged for audit.
interactive.confirm_screening.zh: ✅ 筛选已确认，边界案例已记录审计。

interactive.paused.en: ⏸️ Paused for your confirmation. Review the search strategy above and confirm to proceed.
interactive.paused.zh: ⏸️ 已暂停等待确认。请审阅上述搜索策略后确认继续。

report.first.skeleton.en: 📝 Report-first mode: skeleton emitted, evidence will fill in progressively...
report.first.skeleton.zh: 📝 Report-first 模式：已输出报告骨架，证据将逐步填充...

run.est.background.en: report in seconds, full verification ~1–4 min later
run.est.background.zh: 报告数秒即出，全量验证约 1–4 分钟后回补

run.vmode.top.zh: 仅验证被引前 {n} 条引文

run.vmode.background.zh: 先出未验证预览，验证结果后台回填

topic.translated.zh: 已将中文检索词翻译为英文：{en}

topic.partial.en: Some Chinese terms were not mapped: {rest} — for best recall, use English terms.
topic.partial.zh: 部分中文术语未识别：{rest} —— 为获得最佳召回，建议改用英文检索词。

info.r_code_shown_default.en: [INFO] R code is shown by default in preview mode. Re-run with --show-code while using --yes to also display it during execution.
info.r_code_shown_default.zh: [提示] 预览模式默认展示 R 代码。执行时追加 --show-code 可同时查看代码。]

info.result_saved.zh: 结果 JSON 已保存至：{path}

xlsx.banner.summary.zh: 临床试验检索结果概要

xlsx.banner.raw.zh: 原始明细（归一化字段快照）

xlsx.cover.generated.en: This workbook was auto-generated by ct-registry; a single file, readable offline.
xlsx.cover.generated.zh: 本工作簿由 ct-registry 自动生成，单文件离线可读。

xlsx.scope.range_val.en: WHO ICTRP (global mirror of 14+ primary registries) + China CDE
xlsx.scope.range_val.zh: WHO ICTRP（全球镜像 14+ 一级注册库）+ 中国 CDE

xlsx.scope.source_val.en: WHO ICTRP detail API (via unified endpoint); CDE drug trial registry platform
xlsx.scope.source_val.zh: WHO ICTRP 详情接口（经统一端点）；CDE 药物临床试验登记平台

xlsx.scope.quota_val.en: Free to use; to conserve shared resources, the daily cap is 1000 demands (counted by demand_id). See README.
xlsx.scope.quota_val.zh: 当前免费使用；为充分利用共享资源，每日上限 1000 个需求（按 demand_id 计），详见 README

xlsx.field.registry_id_desc.en: Unique ID per registry (NCT / ChiCTR / DRKS / CTIS / jRCT / ACTRN, etc.)
xlsx.field.registry_id_desc.zh: 各注册库唯一编号（NCT / ChiCTR / DRKS / CTIS / jRCT / ACTRN 等）

xlsx.field.phase_desc.en: Phase (some observational studies have no phase)
xlsx.field.phase_desc.zh: Phase（部分观察性研究无分期）

xlsx.field.enrollment_desc.en: Target sample size / actual total enrolled
xlsx.field.enrollment_desc.zh: Target sample size / 实际入组总人数

xlsx.field.status_desc.en: Recruitment status (Recruiting / Completed, etc.; colour-coded in the master table)
xlsx.field.status_desc.zh: Recruitment status（招募中 / 已完成 等，颜色编码见总表）

xlsx.field.countries_desc.en: Countries of recruitment (CDE is always China)
xlsx.field.countries_desc.zh: Countries of recruitment（CDE 恒为 China）

xlsx.field.start_date_desc.en: Date of registration / first public listing
xlsx.field.start_date_desc.zh: Date of registration / 首次公示信息日期

xlsx.field.url_desc.en: Click to open each registry's official page (blue underline)
xlsx.field.url_desc.zh: 点击直达各注册库官方页面（蓝色下划线）

xlsx.block.phase_status.zh: 九、分期 × 状态 交叉分布

xlsx.note.status_color.en: Colour matches the master-table status coding
xlsx.note.status_color.zh: 颜色与总表状态编码一致

xlsx.note.source.en: WHO ICTRP (global mirror) vs China CDE
xlsx.note.source.zh: WHO ICTRP（全球镜像）vs 中国 CDE

xlsx.note.top12_cde.en: Top 12 only; CDE is always China
xlsx.note.top12_cde.zh: 仅显示前 12 位；CDE 恒为 China

xlsx.note.enroll.zh: 目标/实际入组人数统计

xlsx.note.crosstab.en: Row totals in the last column; the colour scale shows counts
xlsx.note.crosstab.zh: 每行合计见末列；色阶表示数量

xlsx.footer.zh: 第 &P 页 / 共 &N 页 · 生成于 &D

xlsx.summary.intro.en: The tables and charts below are auto-aggregated from the search results: each section shows a distribution table on the left and its chart on the right; the share column carries a data bar, so distributions and trends are grasped at a glance. Extended dimensions include data source, country/region, enrollment and phase×status.
xlsx.summary.intro.zh: 下列数据表与图表由检索结果自动汇总生成：每个分区左侧为分布数据表、右侧为对应统计图；占比列带数据条，便于一眼掌握分布与趋势。含「数据来源 / 国家地区 / 样本量 / 分期×状态」等扩展维度。

xlsx.caveat.text.en: Data caveats: ① If a CDE search returns empty in both Chinese and English, it means the drug has no China drug registration; ② some WHO records lack study type / phase — a source-coverage issue; ③ primary/secondary outcomes and inclusion/exclusion criteria are preserved verbatim, not translated; ④ the WHO advanced-search Phases field is narrow, so phase is verified against the normalized detail.
xlsx.caveat.text.zh: 数据局限：① CDE 经中英双检索为空时表示该药暂无中国药物登记；② 部分 WHO 记录缺研究类型/分期的，属源数据覆盖问题；③ 主要/次要终点与入排标准原文保留，未做翻译；④ WHO 高级检索 Phases 归一化字段较窄，分期以详情归一化复核为准。

xlsx.legend.stopped.zh: 撤回 / 终止 / 暂停

xlsx.safety.banner.zh: FAERS 不良事件检索报告

xlsx.safety.cover.generated.en: Auto-generated by ct-safety from openFDA FAERS public data (drug/event.json). Single file, readable offline.
xlsx.safety.cover.generated.zh: 由 ct-safety 基于 openFDA FAERS 公开数据（drug/event.json）自动生成，单文件离线可读。

xlsx.safety.scope.source_val.en: openFDA FAERS (FDA Adverse Event Reporting System) public API
xlsx.safety.scope.source_val.zh: openFDA FAERS（FDA 不良事件报告系统）公开 API

xlsx.safety.scope.downloaded.zh: 已下载（API 返回顺序前 N 条）

xlsx.safety.scope.downloaded_fast.en: count mode — full matched population (no case download)
xlsx.safety.scope.downloaded_fast.zh: count 模式 — 全量匹配报告（未下载逐条个案）

xlsx.safety.mode_fast.en: count-facet fast fetch (full matched population, seconds)
xlsx.safety.mode_fast.zh: count 分面快取（全量匹配报告，秒级生成）

xlsx.safety.caveat.en: Data caveats: ① Reports are the FIRST N in API return order — NOT a random sample; do not treat proportions as population estimates. ② FAERS is spontaneous reporting, subject to under-reporting and confounding. ③ Age uses mixed units (YR/MON/WK/DY/HR); normalized to years before binning. ④ Reaction / indication / drug-role text is split from semicolon-joined fields and counted verbatim.
xlsx.safety.caveat.zh: 数据局限：① 下载为 API 返回顺序前 N 条，非随机抽样，比例不可当作总体估计；② FAERS 为自发呈报，存在漏报与混杂偏倚；③ 年龄单位混杂（年/月/周/天/时），分箱前已统一折算为岁；④ 反应/指征/药物角色由分号拼接字段拆分后原文计数。

xlsx.safety.note.age.en: Age normalized to years before binning
xlsx.safety.note.age.zh: 分箱前年龄已折算为岁

xlsx.safety.note.role.en: All drug roles across the report
xlsx.safety.note.role.zh: 报告内全部药物角色计数

xlsx.safety.note.age_skip_fast.en: Age distribution is NOT count-able via the API (404) → omitted; use non-fast mode to download cases.
xlsx.safety.note.age_skip_fast.zh: 年龄分布无法经 API 分面统计（404）→ 此处略；如需年龄请用非 --fast 模式下载个案。

xlsx.safety.raw_fast_note.en: Count fast mode did not download case-level records. Use non --fast mode to fetch raw cases.
xlsx.safety.raw_fast_note.zh: count 快取模式未下载逐条个案；如需原始个案请用非 --fast 模式下载。

xlsx.safety.summary_intro.en: The tables and charts below are auto-aggregated from the downloaded FAERS cases: each section shows a distribution table on the left and its chart on the right; the share column carries a data bar. Nine dimensions cover seriousness, sex, report type, source country, age, annual trend, top reactions, top indications and drug role.
xlsx.safety.summary_intro.zh: 下列数据表与图表由下载的 FAERS 个案自动汇总生成：每个分区左侧为分布数据表、右侧为对应统计图；占比列带数据条。涵盖严重性、性别、报告类型、来源国家、年龄、逐年趋势、高频反应、高频指征与药物角色九个维度。

xlsx.safety.summary_intro_fast.en: The dimensions below are aggregated from openFDA count facets over the FULL matched population (generated in seconds, no selection bias). Age is NOT count-able via the API, so the age block is omitted — eight dimensions are shown.
xlsx.safety.summary_intro_fast.zh: 以下维度基于 openFDA count 分面对「全部匹配报告」聚合生成（秒级、无选择偏倚）。年龄无法经 API 分面统计，故略去年龄块；共展示八个维度。

kw_gate.title.en: Keyword system (auto-expand + EN/ZH translation) - confirm / supplement before searching
kw_gate.title.zh: 关键字体系（自动扩展 + 中英互译）- 请确认 / 补充后再检索

kw_gate.opt_adopt.zh: 1. 采用以上关键字体系（推荐）

kw_gate.opt_del.en: 2. Delete specific terms (reply: del term, e.g. del sitagliptin)
kw_gate.opt_del.zh: 2. 删除某些词（回复：删 词，如删 曲格列汀）

kw_gate.opt_add.en: 3. Add your own terms (reply: add term, e.g. add repaglinide)
kw_gate.opt_add.zh: 3. 补充我自己的词（回复：加 词，如加 瑞格列奈）

kw_gate.opt_scope.zh: 4. 改用更窄 / 更宽范围（如只搜 沙格列汀）

kw_gate.after.en: (Search proceeds to scope/quota confirmation only after you confirm)
kw_gate.after.zh: （确认后才进入检索范围/配额确认 - 正式检索）

kw_gate.title_multi.zh: 关键字体系 #{i}（{axis}）- 自动扩展 + 中英互译

kw_gate.multi_confirm.en: Please confirm (the {n} keyword systems above are handled together):
kw_gate.multi_confirm.zh: 请确认（以上 {n} 组关键字体系一并处理）：

kw_gate.stopped.en: [ct_registry][KW-GATE] keyword system not confirmed - search stopped. confirm/supplement, then re-run.
kw_gate.stopped.zh: [ct_registry][KW-GATE] 关键字体系未确认 - 已停止检索。请确认/补充后，重新运行。

kw_gate.multi_opt_adopt.en: 1. Adopt all the above keyword systems (recommended)

error.empty_question.en: [ct-advisor] cannot generate answer: the problem description is empty, please provide a specific clinical-trial question.
error.empty_question.zh: [ct-advisor] 无法生成答案：问题描述为空，请提供具体的临床试验问题。

error.payload_invalid.en: [ct-advisor] payload parse/validation failed ({error}); fell back to local draft, remote NOT called.
error.payload_invalid.zh: [ct-advisor] payload 解析/校验失败（{error}）；已回退本地草稿，未调用远程。

error.refine_fallback.en: [ct-advisor] refine error, falling back to draft: {error}

error.dependency_fatal.en:
[ct-advisor][FATAL] refiner dependency missing: this issue will NOT silently fall back; install per the command below and retry.
     {cmd}
error.dependency_fatal.zh:
[ct-advisor][FATAL] 精校依赖缺失：此问题不会静默回退；请按以下命令安装后重试。
     {cmd}

suggest.few_results_prefix.en: ⚠️ Only {n} unique works found. Consider these options to expand your search:
suggest.few_results_prefix.zh: ⚠️ 仅找到 {n} 篇唯一文献。建议以下扩展检索选项：

suggest.snowball.en: Enable snowball citation-network expansion (+20-40% coverage, zero cost): --snowball
suggest.snowball.zh: 启用滚雪球引文网络扩展（+20~40% 覆盖率，零成本）：--snowball

suggest.deep.en: Use deep search budget (~100 works + rescue): --depth deep
suggest.deep.zh: 使用深度检索预算（~100 篇 + 救援）：--depth deep

suggest.pico.en: Add structured PICO concepts for precise matching: --concept TYPE=VALUE
suggest.pico.zh: 添加结构化 PICO 概念精确匹配：--concept TYPE=VALUE

suggest.rare_disease.en: Use rare-disease specific sources (Orphanet/OMIM/ClinVar): rare_disease tool
suggest.rare_disease.zh: 使用罕见病专源检索（Orphanet/OMIM/ClinVar）：rare_disease 工具
